parentProduct.name: Gain Dryer Sheets
parentProduct.description: More scent. More softness. Less static. Fewer wrinkles. Are you so obsessed with the scent of Gain that it feels like you can never get enough of it? Gain Dryer Sheets to the rescue to add even more Gain scent to your freshly dried clothes and making them even softer. They're like the cherry on top of your pile of clean and freshly scented laundry. What do dryer sheets actually do? Gain Dryer Sheets do all the things you love like soften clothes, give fabrics a delightful scent, reduce wrinkles, and reduce static so your clothes attract fewer bits of lint. And the best part? They do all this without any extra hassle. Gain Dryer Sheets take your laundry to the next level by getting rid of static and adding a fresh, irresistible scent to fabrics. Evoke memories of a warm and airy spring evening of Moonlight Breeze scent you know and love from Gain while enjoying incredibly soft laundry without wrinkles. For daring noses, we hear the trifecta of Gain Moonlight Breeze Scent (laundry detergent + scent booster + dryer sheets) is the best way to go for freshness. Add Gain Dryer Sheets to every load to give your nose the love it deserves with Gain Moonlight Breeze Scent.

parentProduct.name: Gillette Razor
parentProduct.description: The Gillette Fusion5 Power men's razor is a battery-powered razor that provides gentle micro pulses that help the razor glide smoothly over your skin. It features 5 antifriction blades so you can get 5-blade closeness at an affordable price. The blades are spaced closely together for incredible comfort lasting you up to 20 shaves per blade refill. The precision trimmer on the back of the razor makes getting your hard-to-reach places easier and is great for styling your facial hair just the way you want it. Soft micro-fins gently stretch and smooth skin to prepare hairs for a close shave from our thinnest blades (first 4 blades) while the lubrastrip helps the blades glide over your skin more easily. A Lubrastrip is a thin strip that sits at the top of the razor, releasing lubricants while you shave, to produce a great glide. When you are no longer getting an optimal shave, the Lubrastrip fades to white, indicating that it might be time to change the blade. Every Fusion5 handle can fit all Gillette 5-blade razor refills (excluding Gillette Labs).

parentProduct.name: Gillette Sensor3 Men's Disposable Razor, Blue, 4 Razors
parentProduct.description: Looking for a men's disposable razor that can get you up to 12 comfortable shaves? Gillette's Sensor3 Comfort disposable razors do just that thanks to its 3 chromium-coated, skin sensing blades and a 40 degree pivoting head that automatically adjusts to the skin's surface to give a close, smooth and comfortable shave. Additionally, the skin-guard fins have five elastomer fins that gently stretch the skin to create a smooth, even surface for an optimal shave. Each razor can last up to 12 comfortable shaves. Sensor3 disposable razors for men feature an enhanced Lubrastrip with water activated Comfort-gel technology for ultimate comfort and smooth shaving. Complete with an ergonomic shaped non-slip rubber handle for great control and maneuverability and easy rinse blades for 100% better rinsing (vs Sensor2 Plus disposable razors). See why Gillette Sensor3 Men's Disposable razor is the world's #1 selling 3 blade disposable razor*. For best results, use with your favorite Gillette shave gel, cream or foam. *Based on Nielsen sales data among 3 bladed male disposable razors.

parentProduct.name: Tide PODS Laundry Detergent Soap Pacs
parentProduct.description: Discover the effortless, powerful clean of Tide PODS laundry detergent pacs, designed to work on 100% of common stains, even in cold water. With a 3-in-1 concentrated formula that combines stain removers, odor fighters, and color protectors, you get exceptional cleaning performance in just one simple step. Tide PODS laundry soap dissolves quickly, activating stain removal and odor fighting in any wash temperature. Say goodbye to grease stains and hello to fresh, vibrant laundry with America’s top trusted laundry brand*. Don’t pay for water, pay for clean. Tide PODS laundry soap is concentrated with 3X cleaning ingredients per dose compared to leading bargain liquid detergent, ensuring you get the most out of every load. Just toss Tide PODS laundry soap into the drum before adding clothes, it's that easy! For larger or heavily soiled loads, simply add another Tide POD.

parentProduct.name: Gain Flings Liquid Laundry Detergent
parentProduct.description: Gain flings! laundry detergent pacs are packed with 50% more scent than Gain liquid laundry detergent. Armed with the stain-fighting power of Oxi and Febreze, they give you nothing but great, clean, amazing-smelling laundry. Use with any laundry set-up, because Gain flings! Pacs dissolve in both hot and cold water and are HE compatible. Whisk yourself away to a tropical paradise with the help of Gain Flings Island Fresh! Upon dissolving in your wash, these super-concentrated laundry detergent pacs release the alluring scent of exotic fruits and flowers, wrapping your clothes in ahhhmazing freshness.

parentProduct.name: Venus ComfortGlide Disposable Razor for Women
parentProduct.description: Venus female razor blades are designed with a woman's body in mind. From handles designed for a comfortable grip, to pivoting heads that contour to curves, Venus razors for women are designed to help reveal touchably smooth skin. Venus Comfort Glide White Tea disposable women's razors feature 3 curve hugging blades for a smooth, close shave that lasts. These razors come equipped with built in flexible gel bars that, when wet, release rich White Tea scented body butter lather for glide and comfort. The flexible gel bars release a rich White Tea scented body butter lather, guarding your skin against nicks, cuts and irritation. Venus Comfort Glide women's disposable razors feature an adaptive, pivoting design that adjusts to your body's contours and a rounded head that hugs curves and fits easily into hard to shave areas. No awkwardly angling your razor. Also features an ergonomic handle for great control. With Venus Comfort Glide White Tea disposable razors, you can just use and replace when you're ready for a new one. No refills needed. All Skin Types

parentProduct.name: Palmolive Ultra Strength Liquid Dish Soap, 20 fl oz Bottle
parentProduct.description: Palmolive Ultra Strength Liquid Dish Soap is the signature green dish soap and trusted liquid dish soap for every home. This dishwashing liquid features a fresh scent and delivers superior cleaning power; it removes 99.9% of grease and 99.9% of sticky food residue, making it a highly effective dish soap at removing food residue. It works on contact to cut grease and grime. With no soaking required; this dish soap no soaking formula helps you finish the job in one go. It is a paraben free dish soap, contains no phthalates, perfect for families and daily dishwashing. Thanks to its versatility as a multi-purpose cleaner, you can use it as a bbq grill cleaner, car tire cleaner, or pre-treat laundry stain remover in addition to dishes, glasses, pots, pans, and most cookware. It is also powerful on plastics, ensuring even your plastic containers, lunchboxes, and storage lids come out sparkling clean. Palmolive Ultra Strength Dish Soap is the solution for all your kitchen cleaning needs.
